title: Storefront Customer Auth & Profile Management
business_value: Allows storefront customers to securely manage their sessions, update profiles, and secure accounts via change password.
preserved_behavior: Existing customer table schemas, address management endpoints, and admin password reset functionalities.
changed_behavior: Interactive storefront components for Login, Logout, Profile Settings, and a new Change Password self-service flow.

business_rules.rule: Only active customers can log in; suspended accounts receive 403 Forbidden with support contact message.
Password changes require verifying current_password match against DB hash.
New password must be at least 8 characters and distinct from the current password.
Email addresses are read-only for customer profile updates.

acceptance_criteria.given: Customer is on the login page
acceptance_criteria.then: Session token is stored in httpOnly cookie and redirected to dashboard.
Access is denied with status 403 and custom Vietnamese error message.

acceptance_criteria.given: Customer is on Profile Settings tab
acceptance_criteria.when: Submits valid first_name, last_name, phone, B2B details, and GDPR consent
acceptance_criteria.then: Database updates, success toast appears, and local auth state syncs.

acceptance_criteria.given: Customer is logged in and inputs valid current_password, new_password, and matching confirm_new_password
acceptance_criteria.then: Database password hash is updated, success feedback shown, form fields reset, and customer remains logged in.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Password change fails for incorrect current password
acceptance_criteria.given: Customer is logged in and inputs incorrect current_password
acceptance_criteria.then: Database does not update, and error message shows current password incorrect.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Password change fails for password reuse
acceptance_criteria.given: Customer is logged in and inputs current password as new password
acceptance_criteria.then: Form displays validation error and submit is blocked.

edge_cases: Suspended customer session invalidation on active API calls.
Form submission during low network connectivity.
dependencies: Backend endpoint PUT /customer/me/change-password verification check support
open_questions: Do we require double-entry email validation for profile updates?
Should we implement password strength meter thresholds?
